characters.summary: Bellsprout is a Grass and Poison-type Pokémon that utilizes whip-like vines and powder attacks to subdue opponents. It can bend its body to gracefully evade attacks and uses its root-like feet to absorb nutrients.

mechanisms: Flexible body to elude physical strikes

limitations: Slow movement speed on land due to root-like feet

sources.supports: Basic attributes, moves, and elemental weaknesses of Bellsprout

feats.claim: Learns and uses Vine Whip and Sleep Powder in combat
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue game data and associated early anime appearances

unknowns: Exact physical strength limitations outside of standard game stats

characters.summary: Blastoise is a powerful Water-type Pokémon featuring heavy steel cannons on its shell capable of firing high-pressure water jets. It relies on durable defensive plating and overwhelming hydraulic force in battle.
limitations: Heavy shell limits overall running speed

sources.supports: Blastoise baseline abilities, typings, and movepool

feats.claim: Fires water jets from shell cannons capable of punching holes through thick steel
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Naturally breathes underwater as a water-type Pokémon
Fires pressurized water from shell cannons

characters.summary: Gigantamax Blastoise transforms into a massive tower-like fortress featuring multiple secondary cannons alongside its main water barrels. It bombards opponents with massive artillery-style water barrages.
weaknesses: Form wears off after a limited duration
mobility: Stationary or slow movement due to gargantuan size
limitations: Gigantamax form reverts after three turns
characters.formDifferences: Massive increase in physical size, replacement of standard max moves with G-Max Cannonade, and deployment of auxiliary water cannons.

sources.supports: Gigantamax Blastoise form details and G-Max Cannonade move

feats.claim: Uses main cannon and 31 secondary cannons simultaneously to bombard battlefields
feats.citation: Pokémon Sword and Shield Pokédex entries

conditional.ability: Gigantamax form, massive size increase, and G-Max Cannonade access
conditional.dependsOn: Gigantamax energy phenomenon in specific battle regions

campaignTags.claim: Grows to towering proportions via Gigantamax phenomenon
Unleashes massive torrents through multiple artillery barrels

unknowns: Exact structural limits of the auxiliary cannons

characters.summary: Mega Blastoise consolidates its dual shell cannons into one central, highly accurate mega launcher mounted on its back. It engages foes with sniper-like precision water blasts.

mechanisms: Enhanced shell durability via Mega Evolution

limitations: Mega Evolution lasts only for the duration of a single battle
characters.formDifferences: Replaces dual cannons with a single massive central cannon, boosts combat stats, and gains the Mega Launcher ability.

sources.supports: Mega Blastoise stats, Mega Launcher ability, and design features

feats.claim: HITS targets with high precision from over six miles away using its central main cannon

conditional.ability: Mega Evolution transformation and Mega Launcher ability boost
conditional.dependsOn: Blastoisinite held item and Trainer resonance

campaignTags.claim: Fires concentrated blasts from its central mega launcher

unknowns: Stamina drain caused by prolonged mega evolution

limitations: Relies heavily on stored sunlight for prolonged energy exertion

feats.claim: Can nap for days by absorbing sunlight through the bulb on its back
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Restores health using energy absorbed via Leech Seed

unknowns: Maximum weight capacity of its vines

limitations: Extremely limited physical strength and low speed
